concerns.text: The data‑model (data-model.md) defines a `word_count` column for the `Participant` entity in the interim cleaned CSV, but the implementation plan’s description of `data/interim/cleaned_adress.csv` omits this column entirely. This creates a mismatch: the plan does not produce a field that the data model specifies, violating the Plan ↔ Data‑Model consistency rule.
